list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18; hidden flags, tracked counts, missable flag and guides researched 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is automatic: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to chase. Plan around the long tail instead — 100% completion, the collectible sets and the activity grinds. Keep cheats off, too: launch coverage reports that turning on a cheat disables trophies and saving for the session.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the story. It is a hidden story trophy, so it simply unlocks as you play the introduction — no choices or side objectives are involved. Because it comes first, it needs no save protection either.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 1 of the story: play the chapter's missions in order and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Before you move on, take the Chapter 1 meditation moment Lucia is offered on her balcony if you are chasing Positive Mental Attitude — reported guides say that spot does not come back in later chapters.

Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary: with no mission replay in the game, a chapter-start save is your insurance for anything chapter-specific.

Finishing the story also reveals the full 100% checklist in the stats menu, which is where the endgame grind is tracked.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big gold: reach 100% on the game's completion tracker. GTABase notes the checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) shows up after the story, that everything you did before already counts, and that nothing on the checklist itself is missable. Work it after the finale — story strands, collectibles, activities and exploration all feed it — and expect a long haul: guides estimate the full platinum run at roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, the jump and stunt spots scattered around Leonida. This is a long grind rather than a skill test, so chip away at stunt locations whenever you pass one instead of leaving all 250 for the endgame. Every stunt also counts toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the game tracks 9 activity types. Sample everything as it unlocks (races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range and the rest) and this pops early. It is one of the cheapest trophies on the list, and a good preview of what the completion grind asks for later.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the challenges weapon class by weapon class and replay any that fall short of gold — unlike story missions, range challenges can be retried freely. Clearing all 42 also feeds your 100% completion.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total. The trophy needs one win at each course, not a medal sweep, and the races are repeatable, so retry a course until the win lands.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The wins must come in 20 distinct races, so move around the race calendar instead of replaying a favourite. Race wins also count toward completion.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, accept it and land the better catch under its rules. It is an activity trophy, so it can be attempted in free roam once fishing is available.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Head to an arcade cabinet in free roam and play a game through to the end — a single finished game is all it takes, which makes this one of the quickest bronzes on the list.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida and gathered into sets; the trophy needs three full sets, not three loose cards. Treat it as a collectible sweep and combine the hunt with exploration for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Each new location where you use it adds to the counter, so use it whenever you reach a fresh spot rather than repeating one place. At 100 locations, this silver is one of the bigger collectible-style grinds on the list.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the short tracked tasks the game offers around the world, and any mix of 50 finishes the trophy. They overlap heavily with normal play, so when you are short, open the challenge list and pick off the nearly-done ones.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level up to four stars while Jason and Lucia are together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears — both partners have to get away. Reported coverage says the partner trophies open up once both leads are playable in Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one continuous wanted run with both partners present, moving straight from shop to shop; if the wanted level drops between robberies, the chain resets. Pick three nearby shops before you start.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded fight, trigger Combat Focus once and drop five enemies before it ends. A story firefight or a gang operation gives you the density you need, and a short attempt costs nothing — just try again.

trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, take a plane and lift off from the airport without clearance. It is a hidden one-off secret rather than a mission: get airside, take an aircraft and get airborne. Expect a wanted level for it, so enjoy the escape.

trophies.guide: The description only says 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — a Rhino is the game's tank, so this hidden trophy is earned in an encounter involving one. Launch coverage groups it with the free-roam secret trophies without a fully confirmed method, so if you meet a Rhino in free roam, engage with it and survive the encounter. Keep a recent save first: tanks are not forgiving.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quietly and get out before any alarm or witness flags you — detection at any point voids the attempt. It is repeatable in free roam, so a blown attempt just means trying the next store.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the tracker counts 52 areas. Travel the whole map, including the outlying islands and rural corners, until every area has been visited at least once. Pair the sweep with collectible hunting so no trip is wasted.
